svg.title: UC-16 · Ranking over the Ansiblex jump gates each character can see

g.text: UC-16 · Ranking over the Ansiblex jump gates each character can see
choose Ansiblex (fourth radio button, kept in the evedm_prefs cookie)
[a character's gate list is older than refresh_hours (6 h)]
structure IDs the character can see
ansiblex_gates (dest_system_id parsed from the name; not_gate / no_access kept)
one-way links system -> system the character can see
path + positions of the Ansiblex hops (BFS over stargates + links, 1 jump each)
rows with jumps, route_legs [gate | ansiblex], ansiblex{status, gates, jumps, direct_jumps, used, hops}
"via Ansiblex" badge, hop chips in the route bar, dotted cyan legs labelled Ansiblex on the map
ESI has no gate list and no access list: a gate found by the character's own search is treated as usable
